tecla.corpus.metadata module¶

Metadata extraction utilities for TECLA’s corpus module.

This module provides heuristics to infer: - author name, - publication year, - document title, - text type (article / book chapter / other).

The heuristics are based on filename patterns commonly used in academic PDFs. The goal is not perfect bibliographic accuracy but a reliable, reproducible approximation suitable for corpus metadata.

tecla.corpus.metadata.infer_metadata(filename)[fuente]¶

Infer metadata (author, year, title, text_type) from a PDF filename.

Supports two layers: 1. TECLA-pattern files: <Author, N.>_<YYYY>_<title>.pdf 2. General heuristic fallback (original implementation)

Parámetros:

filename (str) – PDF name or full path.

Devuelve:

{

“author”: str or None, “year”: int or None, “title”: str or None, “text_type”: “unknown”

}

Tipo del valor devuelto:

dict

tecla.corpus.pdf_to_txt module¶

PDF-to-text conversion for TECLA corpus module.

This module performs a neutral extraction of textual content from PDFs using pdfminer.six. No linguistic or structural cleaning is applied. Cleaning operations must be explicitly requested through the cleaning module.

tecla.corpus.pdf_to_txt.pdf_to_text(pdf_path)[fuente]¶

Convert a PDF file into plain text.

No cleanup heuristics (e.g., removing headers, page numbers, short lines) are applied here. The goal is faithful extraction of the raw textual content.

Parámetros:

pdf_path (str) – Full path to the PDF file.

Devuelve:

Extracted raw text from the PDF.

Tipo del valor devuelto:

str

tecla.corpus.utils module¶

Utility functions used internally by the TECLA corpus module.

These helpers manage: - folder creation, - PDF file discovery, - stoplist loading, - safe file reading and writing.

All functions here are intended for internal use.

Devuelve:

str

tecla.corpus.utils.load_stoplist(stoplist)[fuente]¶

Load a stoplist from a file path or accept a user-provided list.

Parámetros:

stoplist (str or list or None) –

  • If None: return an empty set (caller decides default behaviour).

  • If str: interpret it as a file path (one token per line).

  • If list: convert it into a set.

Devuelve:

A set of stopwords to be removed.

Tipo del valor devuelto:

set[str]
